title: Relieved
html_source: A type of suspense separate from that of Calypso is on show in Lotus Eaters. Norris calls it that of Marie Laure Ryan’s meta-suspense ‘where the focus of the reader’s concern is not to find out what happens in the textual world but how the author is going to tie all the strands together and give the text proper narrative form’.(Norris,M. Virgin and Veteran Readings of Ulysses, p95).
